description: This Java source file defines the class PolicyModifyCommandResponseAdapter, which acts as an adapter for mapping PolicyModifyCommandResponse objects to and from an internal representation (Adaptable). It is part of a protocol adapter system for policies within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PolicyModifyCommandResponseAdapter
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractPolicyAdapter that provides mechanisms to adapt PolicyModifyCommandResponse objects to the internal Adaptable format and vice versa. It includes a static factory method for instantiation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of PolicyModifyCommandResponseAdapter, validating the input HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: getTypeCriterionAsString
methods.description: Overrides a protected method to return the specific string criterion used for identifying response topics.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyModifyCommandResponseAdapter instance with the provided HeaderTranslator after null check.

methods.name: getTypeCriterionAsString
methods.description: Returns the string constant 'RESPONSES_CRITERION' for identifying response topics.
